summary:
[  edit  ]
The Delete  SOP  deletes input geometry as selected by a group specification or a geometry selection by using either of the three selection options: by entity number, by a bounding volume, and by entity (primitive/point) normals. You can choose to delete the selected or the non-selected geometry.

parameters.label: Use Number
parameters.name: usenumber
parameters.description: When the Enable button is checked under the Number button, the selection options become active and can be used to select entities. The fields available are listed below.

parameters.label: Operation
parameters.name: groupop
parameters.description: ⊞  - When the Number Enable button is checked, this option groups entities based on a defined Pattern or by a Range.

parameters.label: Delete by Pattern
parameters.name: pattern
parameters.description: Select a pattern in the Pattern field below.

parameters.label: Delete by Range
parameters.name: range
parameters.description: Select a Range using the Start/End and Select_of_ fields below.

parameters.label: Delete by  Expression
parameters.name: filter
parameters.description: Select a range using the Filter  Expression  field below.

parameters.label: Pattern
parameters.name: pattern
parameters.description: Activated when Operation is set to  Group  by Pattern. In this field, enter the range of primitives to select. The required syntax is " S.P ", where  S  is the index of the parent surface, and  P  the profile index on that surface. You can mix primitives with profiles in the list. A mixed group is automatically ordered.
6  selects six profiles on primitive 0

parameters.label: Start / End
parameters.name: range
parameters.description: ⊞  - Activated when Operation is set to  Group  by Range. Select the start and end of the primitive/point number selection.

parameters.label: Select _ of _
parameters.name: select
parameters.description: ⊞  - Activated when Operation is set to  Group  by Range. Select every nth occurrence of every mth entity in the above Start/End range.

parameters.label: Filter  Expression
parameters.name: filter
parameters.description: The Filter  Expression  provided is evaluated for every point/primitive. Wherever it is true, the entity is added to the selection.

parameters.label: Use Bounds
parameters.name: usebounds
parameters.description: When the Enable button is checked under the Bounding button, the selection options become active and can be used to select entities. The fields available are listed below. The bounding volume can be seen in the viewport as guide geometry.

parameters.label: Bounding Type
parameters.name: boundtype
parameters.description: ⊞  - Selects the type of bounding volume to use:

parameters.label: Bounding Box
parameters.name: usebbox
parameters.description: Bounding Box entities contained within the box are selected.

parameters.label: Bounding Sphere
parameters.name: usebsphere
parameters.description: Bounding Sphere entities contained within the sphere are selected.

parameters.label: Size
parameters.name: size
parameters.description: ⊞  - Dimensions of either the Bounding Box or Bounding Sphere in X, Y and Z.

parameters.label: Center
parameters.name: t
parameters.description: ⊞  - The X, Y, and Z coordinates of the center of the bounding volume.

parameters.label: Use Normal
parameters.name: usenormal
parameters.description: When the Enable button is checked under the Normal button, the selection options become active and can be used to select entities. The fields available are listed below.

parameters.label: Direction
parameters.name: dir
parameters.description: ⊞  - The default values of  0, 1, 0  create a normal vector straight up in Y, which is perpendicular to the XZ plane, which becomes the primary axis. The  1, 0, 0  points the normal in positive X, giving a normal axis perpendicular to the YZ. The plane may be positioned at an angle by using values typed in ( 1, 1, 0  gives a 45 angle plane) or interactively by using the direction vector jack. Values between 0 and 1 should be used.

parameters.label: Spread Angle
parameters.name: angle
parameters.description: The value entered in this field generates an angle of deviation from the primary axis. This can be visualized as a cone where the radius of the base of the cone is defined by the Spread Angle and the axis of the cone is determined by the Direction axis. Viewing the primitive normals in the viewport, you can see that any primitives with normals that have an angle that lies in the range of angles defined by the cone will be selected and grouped.

parameters.label: Backface from
parameters.name: camera
parameters.description: This menu allows you to select an object. Typically, a camera object would be chosen. The primitives which are backface when viewed from the object specified will be grouped or selected.

parameters.label: Delete Unused Groups
parameters.name: removegrp
parameters.description: If any group has 0 entries and if this parameter is enabled, then those groups are removed. If you want to keep empty groups, disable this parameter.

parameters.label: Delete  Geometry , Keep Points
parameters.name: keeppoints
parameters.description: Deletes the geometry but keeps the points.

parameters.label: num_points
parameters.description: Number of points in this  SOP .

parameters.label: num_prims
parameters.description: Number of primitives in this  SOP .

parameters.label: num_particles
parameters.description: Number of particles in this  SOP .

parameters.label: last_vbo_update_time
parameters.description: Time spent in another thread updating geometry data on the  GPU  from the  SOP 's CPU data. As it is part of another thread, this time is not part of the usual frame time.

parameters.label: last_meta_vbo_update_time
parameters.description: Time spent in another thread updating meta surface geometry data (such as metaballs or nurbs) on the  GPU  from the  SOP 's CPU data. As it is part of another thread, this time is not part of the usual frame time.

parameters.label: total_cooks
parameters.description: Number of times the operator has cooked since the process started.

parameters.label: cook_time
parameters.description: Duration of the last cook in milliseconds.

parameters.label: cook_frame
parameters.description: Frame number when this operator was last cooked relative to the component timeline.

parameters.label: cook_abs_frame
parameters.description: Frame number when this operator was last cooked relative to the absolute time.

parameters.label: cook_start_time
parameters.description: Time in milliseconds at which the operator started cooking in the frame it was cooked.

parameters.label: cook_end_time
parameters.description: Time in milliseconds at which the operator finished cooking in the frame it was cooked.

parameters.label: cooked_this_frame
parameters.description: 1 if operator was cooked this frame.

parameters.label: warnings
parameters.description: Number of warnings in this operator if any.

parameters.label: errors
parameters.description: Number of errors in this operator if any.
